turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Okay. Here is one solved for you.
I saw ___ owl. "Owl" starts with the sound "o". That is a vowel sound, so I use "an": I saw an owl.
Rule: before a vowel sound use "an"; before other sounds use "a".
Right: I saw a bird. Wrong: I saw an bird.
Your turn. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
